newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Plane with gold cargo crashes in Brazil, 4 dead.
newsitem.headline: Plane with gold cargo crashes in Brazil, 4 dead.

text.p: A twin-engined plane carrying a cargo of gold bars crashed in the north-eastern Brazilian state of Bahia Thursday and all four people on board were killed, police said on Friday.
"The plane had been hired by Brinks security firm to pick up a cargo of gold from Jacobina and take it to Rio de Janeiro," a police official said.
It crashed shortly after take-off about 150 yards (metres) from the airport in Jacobina, 190 miles (305 km) from the regional capital Salvador.
The official could not give the cause of the crash, but newspapers reported one of the engines had failed. An estimated 87 kg (192 pounds) of gold were aboard the plane, he said.
The four victims included a 48-year-old employee of Brinks, a 35-year-old man working for the Bahia Air Taxi Service and two pilots, aged 30 and 41.
